description: This file defines an API controller named AssetsController, which provides CRUD operations for Asset entities. It includes endpoints to get all assets, get an asset by ID, create, update, and delete assets, using Entity Framework Core for data access.

classes.name: AssetsController
classes.description: API controller for managing asset entities, providing endpoints for CRUD operations.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Retrieves all assets, optionally filtered by a query string parameter 'q'.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific asset by its ID.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new asset from provided data.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing asset identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes an asset identified by ID.
